evidence_spans.snippet: The EMC1413-A and EMC1414-A SMBus slave address is determined by the pull-up resistor on the THERM pin as shown in Table 5.1
For the first 15ms after power-up the device may not respond to SMBus communications.
all temperatures are stored as an 11-bit value with the high byte representing the integer value and the low byte representing the fractional value left justified to occupy the MSBits.
The default range is from 0°C to +127°C and the temperature is represented as binary number able to report a temperature from 0°C to +127.875°C in 0.125°C steps.
The Configuration Register controls the basic operation of the device.
The Conversion Rate Register controls how often the temperature measurement channels are updated and compared against the limits.
The Product ID Register holds a unique value that identifies the device.
The Manufacturer ID register contains an 8-bit word that identifies Microchip as the manufacturer.

requires_human: The SMBus address decode table lists binary addresses with (r/w) suffix; these are 8-bit wire form addresses. The 7-bit addresses were derived by right-shifting by 1. The default address for EMC1413-A with 10k pull-up is 0x4C (1001_100b >> 1 = 0x4C). Confirm that the default pull-up resistor is 10k as per typical application.
The EMC1413-1 and EMC1413-3 hard-coded addresses are given as 1001_100(r/w) and 0011_000(r/w) respectively; these are 8-bit forms. Derived 7-bit addresses: 0x4C and 0x18. Confirm.

The datasheet mentions EMC1413-1 and EMC1413-3 variants but does not specify which variant is the target. Assuming EMC1413-A (address set by resistor) is the primary target. If a specific variant is intended, adjust address_rule accordingly.

init_sequence.notes: Wait 15ms after power-up before SMBus communication.
Write Configuration register (0x03) with default 0x00: active mode, ALERT interrupt mode, default range, dynamic averaging enabled.
Write Conversion Rate register (0x04) with default 0x06: 4 conversions per second.

read_sequence.notes: Read temperature channels: set pointer to high byte register, read high byte, then set pointer to low byte register, read low byte.

timing_constraints.name: power_up_smbus_ready
timing_constraints.notes: For the first 15ms after power-up the device may not respond to SMBus communications.

timing_constraints.name: conversion_period
timing_constraints.notes: Default conversion rate is 4 conversions per second.

timing_constraints.name: smbus_timeout
timing_constraints.notes: If the clock line is held low for longer than 30ms, the device will reset its SMBus protocol.

conversion_formulae.name: temperature_from_raw_default
conversion_formulae.formula: Temperature (°C) = integer_high_byte + (fractional_low_byte >> 5) * 0.125, for default range 0°C to +127.875°C.

inputs.name: low_byte
inputs.description: Low byte: bits 7-5 fractional (0.125°C/LSB), bits 4-0 zero.

error_conditions.name: diode_fault
error_conditions.description: Diode fault detected on external diode channel (FAULT bit in Status register set).
error_conditions.detection: Read Status register (0x02) and check FAULT bit (bit 2). Read External Diode Fault register (0x1B) to identify channel.
error_conditions.driver_action: Report error and optionally retry or mask channel.

error_conditions.name: smbus_nack
error_conditions.detection: SMBus controller detects NACK after sending byte.

power_states.name: active
power_states.description: ADC converting on all channels at programmed conversion rate.

power_states.name: standby
power_states.description: Most circuitry powered down, SMBus active, no conversions.

evidence_spans.snippet: The EMC1413-A and EMC1414-A SMBus slave address is determined by the pull-up resistor on the THERM pin as shown in Table 5.1
For the first 15ms after power-up the device may not respond to SMBus communications.
all temperatures are stored as an 11-bit value with the high byte representing the integer value and the low byte representing the fractional value left justified to occupy the MSBits.
The default range is from 0°C to +127°C and the temperature is represented as binary number able to report a temperature from 0°C to +127.875°C in 0.125°C steps.
The Configuration Register controls the basic operation of the device.
The Conversion Rate Register controls how often the temperature measurement channels are updated and compared against the limits.
The Product ID Register holds a unique value that identifies the device.
The Manufacturer ID register contains an 8-bit word that identifies Microchip as the manufacturer.

requires_human: The SMBus address decode table lists binary addresses with (r/w) suffix; these are 8-bit wire form addresses. The 7-bit addresses were derived by right-shifting by 1. The default address for EMC1413-A with 10k pull-up is 0x4C (1001_100b >> 1 = 0x4C). Confirm that the default pull-up resistor is 10k as per typical application.
The EMC1413-1 and EMC1413-3 hard-coded addresses are given as 1001_100(r/w) and 0011_000(r/w) respectively; these are 8-bit forms. Derived 7-bit addresses: 0x4C and 0x18. Confirm.

The datasheet mentions EMC1413-1 and EMC1413-3 variants but does not specify which variant is the target. Assuming EMC1413-A (address set by resistor) is the primary target. If a specific variant is intended, adjust address_rule accordingly.
